Plate diameter in the image is about 360 px. If it is a dinner plate of 26 cm, that gives roughly 0.072 cm per px.

The chicken drumstick is about 200 px long, or about 14 cm, and about 70 px wide, or about 5 cm. That is a medium drumstick, roughly 110 g with the bone. Cooked drumstick with skin is about 200 kcal/100g.

The black beans cover about 130 x 130 px at the widest, which is about 9 x 9 cm. Allowing for an irregular shape, I estimate an area of about 60 cm² and a height of about 2 cm, giving about 100 cm³. Beans at about 0.85 g/cm³ come to roughly 100 g. Cooked black beans are about 130 kcal/100g.

There is also a little orange sauce or oil near the beans, which I estimate at 10 g.
